summary_md: **DwarfStar ([@DwarfStarDS4](https://x.com/DwarfStarDS4/status/2115775908225171595))** introduces **ds4 (DwarfStar)**, a small native inference engine for DeepSeek V4 Flash, GLM and Qwen on Metal, CUDA and ROCm that streams weights from SSD when the model exceeds RAM and ships its own coding agent ([antirez/ds4](https://github.com/antirez/ds4)).
